tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had utilized CENVAT Credit for payment of Service Tax involving amount of Rs. 11.39 Lakh but the Service Tax Department did not allow the same. Being aggrived, the company preferred an Appeal before CESTAT and CESTAT has allowed the Appeal in favor of the company vide its order dated 30.03.2012. Department has filed an appeal before the Honbl'e Allahabad High Court.

The Company had received Showcause Notice from Directorate of Revenue Intelligence regarding evasion of custom duty in respect of two DEPB Licence involving Value of Rs. 9,31,779/- & 4,95,211/- respectively) on 06.03.2014. Addl, Commissioner- Custom JNPT passed order against the Company confirming demand of Rs. 14.27 Lakh for Custom duty and Rs. 2.15 Lakhs for Penalty. The Company has filed an appeal before CESTAT, Mumbai on 08.08.2016.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioner of Custom - Jawaharlal Nehru Custom House ("JNPT"), Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: Matter not listed for hearing so far

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had received Show Cause Notice on 10.02.2019 from Service Tax department regarding non payment of Service tax (Rs. 76.59 Lakh) on ocean Freight paid by foreign suppliers on the Company's imports under RCM. However, the Company has filed Writ Petition against the said Show Cause Notice before Allahabad High Court on 06.03.2019.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioners Central Excise, Service Tax Moradabad

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received summon from Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Kolkata regarding evasion of custom duty paid through DEPB License and has confirmed the demand of Rs. 11.47 Lakhs for Custom Duty + Rs. 11.47 Lakhs for Penalty and Rs. 11.47 Lakhs for Interest . Being aggrived, the company filed an Appeal before CESTAT but CESAT passed the order against us on 16.01.2020. Now company has filed an Appeal before the Delhi High Court in November, 2020

operating_notes.text: Ethanol plant capacity expansion approved from 180 KL per day to 240 KL per day at an estimated cost of ₹25 Cr.
Ethanol plant capacity successfully enhanced and approved to operate at 240 KL per day.

timeline.summary: Vineet Jain submitted the annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming zero promoter share encumbrance for FY26.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹244.63 Cr (+45.3% YoY), net profit ₹26.28 Cr (+133.2% YoY).
2026-05-25: Board approved ₹25 Cr ethanol capacity expansion from 180 KL/day to 240 KL/day via debottlenecking, to be completed by end-2026 using internal accruals
Received Uttar Pradesh Excise Department consent to operate expanded ethanol plant capacity from 180 KL to 240 KL per day.

status_history.evidence: Received consent from Excise Department, Uttar Pradesh Government to operate ethanol capacity at 240 KL per day.

watchlist.text: Ethanol debottlenecking completion and capacity utilization
